summary: The AI coding landscape in 2026 has consolidated around a few dominant platforms: GitHub Copilot remains the broadest-adopted assistant, while Cursor has become the default AI-native IDE for everyday shipping and Claude Code is widely regarded as the strongest pure coding 'brain.' Adoption is increasingly split between IDE-integrated assistants, terminal/CLI agents, and autonomous cloud agents, with multi-model flexibility and agentic autonomy now being the key differentiators.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
strengths: Multi-model selector with broadest provider range
Agent Mode for autonomous multi-file changes
Cloud agent assigns issues and opens PRs
tools.best_for: The pragmatic default for teams already in the GitHub ecosystem needing broad tooling coverage

tools.name: Cursor
strengths: AI-native IDE built as a VS Code fork
Fast inline diffs with developer approval
Multiple model providers with in-editor switching
Strong codebase-wide context and tab completion
tools.best_for: Everyday shipping in an AI-first editor with tight human-in-the-loop control

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.pricing_paid: Included in Claude Pro $20/mo and Max $100-$200/mo; API usage-based
strengths: Plans, edits files and runs shell commands autonomously
Excellent for large, complex multi-step tasks
tools.best_for: Complex autonomous coding tasks requiring deep reasoning over a large codebase

tools.name: OpenAI Codex
tools.pricing_paid: Included with ChatGPT Plus $20/mo, Pro $200/mo; API usage-based
strengths: Parallel task execution in sandboxed environments
Tight integration with GPT frontier models
tools.best_for: Delegating parallel coding tasks to a cloud agent from the ChatGPT ecosystem

tools.name: Amazon Q Developer
tools.best_for: Enterprise teams building and operating on AWS infrastructure

tools.name: Devin Desktop
strengths: Handles end-to-end tasks with planning and execution
tools.best_for: Delegating full tickets to an autonomous AI software engineer

tools.name: Google Gemini Code Assist
strengths: Generous free tier with high completion limits
Large context window via Gemini models
tools.best_for: Developers on Google Cloud wanting a strong free-tier assistant

tools.name: JetBrains AI Assistant / Junie
strengths: Deep understanding of IDE project model
tools.best_for: Developers working primarily inside the JetBrains IDE ecosystem

tools.name: Tabnine
tools.best_for: Security-conscious enterprises needing private, self-hosted AI coding

tools.name: RooCode
tools.pricing_paid: Free open-source extension; pay for model API usage (BYO key)
tools.best_for: Developers wanting an open, reliable agent for big refactors with any model

tools.name: Cline
tools.pricing_paid: Free open-source extension; pay for model API usage (BYO key)
strengths: Runs terminal commands and edits files
tools.best_for: Developers wanting a transparent open-source agent inside VS Code
